    ORDER_ID,
    TABLE_NUM,
    DISH_O AS DishOrdered ,

    ORDER_DATE
FROM orders

ORDER BY ORDER_DATE DESC;

parameters.message: Controllo completato. Nessun prodotto è sotto la soglia minima. Eventuali lotti in scadenza sono segnalati in una mail separata.

options.systemMessage:
Ruolo: Sei l'Assistente Logistico del ristorante. Il tuo compito è monitorare il magazzino e decidere se ordinare nuova merce o avvisare lo staff per prodotti in scadenza.

Logica di Decisione:

SOTTO SCORTA o VICINO ALLA SCADENZA: Se CurrentStock  è inferiore o uguale a MIN_STOCK o se EXPIRY_DATE è a 3 giorni dalla scadenza, prepara una bozza di email professionale per il fornitore SupplierName.

Linee Guida per le Email:
Approccio: Sii gentile e coinciso

Contenuto: Richiedi SuggestedOrderQty unità di ProductName.

Precisione: Cita sempre il codice articolo del fornitore: SupplierCode.

Personalizzazione: Leggi attentamente le SupplierNotes. Se indicano orari preferiti o nomi di referenti (es. "Chiedere di Mario"), usali nella mail.

Alla fine firmati sempre con: Cordiali saluti, Lo staff del Ristorante Boria's

Output richiesto: Utilizza lo strumento di creazione bozza. IMPORTANTE: Non appena ricevi conferma dal tool che la bozza è stata creata, fornisci una 'Final Answer' brevissima (es: 'Bozza creata') e fermati. Non iterare ulteriormente

INSERT INTO pending_orders 
  (supplier_id, product_id, supplier_product_code, ordered_quantity, ordered_unit, gmail_thread_id)
SELECT 
  s.supplier_id,
  sp.product_id,
  '{{ $json.supplierCode }}',
  {{ $json.orderedQty }},
  '{{ $json.orderedUnit }}',
  '{{ $json.threadId }}'
FROM suppliers s
JOIN supplier_products sp ON s.supplier_id = sp.supplier_id
WHERE s.sup_mail = '{{ $json.supplierEmail }}'
AND sp.supplier_product_code = '{{ $json.supplierCode }}'
LIMIT 1;

START TRANSACTION;

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE tmp_need AS
SELECT 
  r.PROD_R_ID AS product_id,
  SUM(r.Q_NEEDED * o.Tot_Dish_Sold) AS need
FROM recipe r
JOIN (
  SELECT DISH_O, SUM(QUANTITY) AS Tot_Dish_Sold
  FROM orders
  WHERE ORDER_DATE >= NOW() - INTERVAL 8 HOUR
  GROUP BY DISH_O
) o ON r.DISH_NAME = o.DISH_O
GROUP BY r.PROD_R_ID;

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE tmp_batch AS
SELECT 
  b.batch_id,
  b.product_id,
  b.quantity,
  COALESCE(SUM(b.quantity) OVER (
    PARTITION BY b.product_id 
    ORDER BY b.expiry_date ASC, b.batch_id ASC 
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
  ), 0) AS qty_before
FROM batch b
WHERE b.quantity > 0;

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE tmp_consume AS
SELECT 
  tb.batch_id,
  GREATEST(0, LEAST(tb.quantity, tn.need - tb.qty_before)) AS consumed
FROM tmp_batch tb
JOIN tmp_need tn ON tb.product_id = tn.product_id;

INSERT INTO batch_archive 
  (batch_id, batch_number, product_id, initial_quantity, expiry_date, unit_cost, supplier_id, received_date)
SELECT b.batch_id, b.batch_number, b.product_id, b.initial_quantity, b.expiry_date, b.unit_cost, b.supplier_id, b.received_date
FROM batch b
JOIN tmp_consume tc ON b.batch_id = tc.batch_id
WHERE (b.quantity - tc.consumed) <= 0 AND tc.consumed > 0;

DELETE b FROM batch b
JOIN tmp_consume tc ON b.batch_id = tc.batch_id
WHERE (b.quantity - tc.consumed) <= 0 AND tc.consumed > 0;

UPDATE batch b
JOIN tmp_consume tc ON b.batch_id = tc.batch_id
SET b.quantity = b.quantity - tc.consumed
WHERE (b.quantity - tc.consumed) > 0 AND tc.consumed > 0;

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE tmp_need;
DROP TEMPORARY TABLE tmp_batch;
DROP TEMPORARY TABLE tmp_consume;

UPDATE rest_inventory ri
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS tot_qty,
         SUM(quantity * unit_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(quantity), 0) AS wac
  FROM batch GROUP BY product_id
) agg ON ri.PRODUCT_ID = agg.product_id
SET ri.QUANTITY = COALESCE(agg.tot_qty, 0),
    ri.UNIT_COST = COALESCE(agg.wac, ri.UNIT_COST);

COMMIT;

SELECT 
  ri.PRODUCT_ID,
  ri.NAME AS ProductName,
  COALESCE(SUM(b.quantity), 0) AS CurrentStock,
  ri.MIN_STOCK,
  ri.UNIT,
  s.sup_name AS SupplierName,
  s.sup_mail AS SupplierEmail,
  sp.supplier_product_code AS SupplierCode,
  sp.price_per_unit AS CatalogPrice,
  CEILING(((ri.MIN_STOCK * 2) - COALESCE(SUM(b.quantity), 0)) * 10) / 10 AS SuggestedOrderQty,
  s.notes AS SupplierNotes
FROM rest_inventory ri
LEFT JOIN batch b ON b.product_id = ri.PRODUCT_ID
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT 
    product_id, supplier_id, supplier_product_code, price_per_unit,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY is_preferred DESC) AS rn
  FROM supplier_products
) sp ON ri.PRODUCT_ID = sp.product_id AND sp.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON sp.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
GROUP BY ri.PRODUCT_ID, ri.NAME, ri.MIN_STOCK, ri.UNIT, s.sup_name, s.sup_mail, sp.supplier_product_code, sp.price_per_unit, s.notes
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(b.quantity), 0) <= ri.MIN_STOCK;

SELECT 
  b.batch_id,
  b.batch_number,
  ri.NAME AS ProductName,
  b.quantity AS BatchQuantity,
  ri.UNIT,
  b.expiry_date,
  DATEDIFF(b.expiry_date, CURDATE()) AS DaysToExpiry
FROM batch b
JOIN rest_inventory ri ON b.product_id = ri.PRODUCT_ID
WHERE b.quantity > 0
  AND b.expiry_date <= CURDATE() + INTERVAL 3 DAY
ORDER BY b.expiry_date ASC;
